verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no gaming claims and no independent game benchmarks. The only vendor figures are the 5.0 GHz CPU boost and the 228 GB/s memory bandwidth, which do not show real-game frame rates. No cache, integrated-GPU class or frame-rate data is cited, and community comments note the absence of benchmarks and recommend waiting for independent reviews.

support.subject: As a gamer, this chip drives high frame rates in real games — vendor gaming claims (cache, boost behavior, integrated GPU class) corroborated by independent game benchmarks
